item.title: VeriTrust
item.description:
Verification subscription

$29/month VeriTrust

VeriTrust runs the same kind of structural audit behind the public carney.wiki verification report against your own site: what is discoverable, provable, and buyer-verifiable, scored and tied to evidence. Then it re-checks on a schedule so you can see what actually changed.

Monthly subscription Deterministic, evidence-backed scoring Private report, not a public case study
Book a VeriTrust walkthrough See a real VeriTrust report See all offers

The problem

Buyers and AI systems no longer take a website's claims at face value. They check what is actually published: titles, descriptions, structured data, trust and pricing pages, working links, and proof. Most sites have never been audited against that standard, so nobody actually knows what is missing.

I help leadership teams evaluate AI, cloud storage, Microsoft Copilot, file governance, and workflow automation decisions before they become expensive, hard-to-reverse platform commitments.

AI + governance strategy Vendor-neutral advisory Operator-led judgment
Buy the sprint Send me your AI platform question Book a conversation See all offers
